==== client.ts
// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A typed function per route of each HTTP server, sending its arguments and
// decoding its result as the servers' JSON. Framework-neutral: hooks.ts adds
// React on top.

import type * as $t from "./types";

// [react]'s api_base, which each route's path goes after.
export const $base = "http://127.0.0.1:8099";

/** Runs proc Count: `GET /count` on http server api. */
export async function count(args: { readonly by: number }, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<number> {
  const v = await $call("GET", "/count", {
    "by": $encInt(args.by),
  }, opts);
  return $decInt(v, "result");
}

/** Runs proc Delete: `POST /delete` on http server api. */
export async function delete_(args: { readonly ids: readonly number[]; readonly tags: ReadonlyMap<string, boolean> }, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<void> {
  const v = await $call("POST", "/delete", {
    "ids": $encList($encInt)(args.ids),
    "tags": $encMap($stringKey, $encBool)(args.tags),
  }, opts);
  return $decVoid(v, "result");
}

/** Runs proc Now: `GET /now` on http server clock. */
export async function now(_args: Record<string, never> = {}, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<number> {
  const v = await $call("GET", "/now", {
  }, opts);
  return $decFloat(v, "result");
}

}

export function $enc_CountArgs(x: $t.CountArgs): unknown {

  };
}

export function $dec_CountArgs(v: unknown, at: string): $t.CountArgs {

export function $enc_DeleteArgs(x: $t.DeleteArgs): unknown {

==== hooks.ts
// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A React hook per route of each HTTP server, over client.ts: each gives the
// route's last result or error and whether a call is in flight, and cancels
// calls that are no longer wanted.

import * as React from "react";
import * as $c from "./client";

/**
 * Runs proc Count through count (`GET /count` on http server api): with args,
 * whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useCount(args?: { readonly by: number } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly by: number }, number> {
  return $useCall($c.count, args, opts);
}

/**
 * Runs proc Delete through delete_ (`POST /delete` on http server api): with
 * args, whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useDelete(args?: { readonly ids: readonly number[]; readonly tags: ReadonlyMap<string, boolean> } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly ids: readonly number[]; readonly tags: ReadonlyMap<string, boolean> }, void> {
  return $useCall($c.delete_, args, opts);
}

/**
 * Runs proc Now through now (`GET /now` on http server clock): with args,
 * whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useNow(args?: Record<string, never> | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<Record<string, never>, number> {
  return $useCall($c.now, args, opts);
}


// (the runtime)

######## a proc routed twice
error: [react] names each route's client function after its proc, so http server api's "GET /now" (proc Now) and http server api's "POST /now" (proc Now) would both be now: route each proc once
######## two servers routing one proc
error: [react] names each route's client function after its proc, so http server a's "GET /now" (proc Now) and http server b's "GET /now" (proc Now) would both be now: route each proc once

error: [react] names each route's client function after its proc, so http server api's "POST /a" (proc Delete) and http server api's "POST /b" (proc delete) would both be delete_: route each proc once
